closedFindings.finding: Failure after backup bootout and before the installation try block could leave the old scheduler unloaded without rollback.
closedFindings.closure: The first bootout and all subsequent helper retirement, key installation, plist replacement and bootstrap steps are now within the try/rollback boundary.

closedFindings.finding: The old scheduled job could start between the initial idle check and bootout, leaving a writer or lock after interruption while installation continued.
closedFindings.closure: The installer now rechecks writer processes and both snapshot/cycle locks after bootout and refuses to proceed on a race; rejection goes through rollback. The known-writer pattern set additionally includes admin-install-macos.ts and backup-application-drill.mjs.
closedFindings.limit: The checks detect and reject a raced stop; they are not claimed to atomically prevent any concurrent start or an opaque operator script.

A successful bootstrap is not a successful registration. Actual same-package snapshot, M5 read, application drill and legal registration receipts must be independently checked after execution.
The old helper remains retired on rollback by design; original old-cycle entrypoints do not call that helper.
This review performs no remote mutations, secret-key reads, scheduler changes or backup/restore execution.
